page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head top left, page number top right, signature "R 2" at the foot beside the last line.

main_text.p: que tua impinguabit, & eris veluti hortus irriguus, ac veluti scaturigo aquarum, cujus aquæ non deficient: & erunt ex te qui ædificabunt deserta longi temporis, fundamenta generationis & generationis stare facies: vocaberisque sciens rupturam, reductor semitarum ad habitandum. Vide quantum nobis boni offeratur, si panem vitæ obtulerimus afflictis: tenebricosam mentem nostram, meridiano Spiritus sui splendore illuminabit, & ubi alij præ Spiritualium aquarum inopia pereunt, nos ex puteo videntis & viventis larga manu aquabit: ponetque nos velut hortum irriguum, in quo sponsus Sanctorū Christus sese oblectabit, myrrhā suam & aromata & suffitus in nobis colligens, ex arboribus thuriferis & aromaticis, quæ in corde nostro plantabit. Erit alia plane rerum constitutio, quam cui hacte-nus assuevimus: sentiemusque nos relictâ terrâ cælo appropinquasse, quum cœlestia opera Domini, regni sui limites protendentis quovis momento percipiemus. Eritque vox ovationis & salutis in tabernaculis justorum, quia dextera Domini potentiam exercebit: cujus efficacia, non minor erit in nobis confirmandis, quam reliquis infidelibus ad fidei obedien-

page.notes: Stray marks in the text block (slashes near "rupturam" and "meridiano", a small mark at "sentiemusque") look like paper marks or show-through, not printed text. "relictâ" and "terrâ" are printed with a circumflex-like mark, transcribed as shown. "sentiemusque" is printed as "fentiemufque" with long-s forms, read as sentiemusque.
